verdict.rationale: Perplexity Computer is an agent, but it ships a first-party hosted MCP server, so the server axis applies. The docs give a one-line `claude mcp add` HTTP-transport setup and say any HTTP-capable MCP client can connect. They also cover OAuth via a Perplexity account, session continuation via `thread_id`, progress notifications, approvals, and `auth_required` flows. Runtime probes confirm the endpoint is live, returning a clean OAuth 401 challenge and RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent confirmation of a full authenticated end-to-end task run through the MCP server, and community reports of real-world use.
